title: Fare Automation Platform
tagline: Self-service, event-driven fare calculation on industry fare standards.
problem: Fare calculation relied on manual, slow processes with limited flexibility for pricing analysts.
approach: Built a real-time fare workflow UI with Angular 16, NgRx and AG-Grid
Pushed live processing status to users via SignalR
Queried Parquet files directly from S3 with DuckDB and streamed results into AG-Grid
Orchestrated processing with S3, EventBridge, Python Lambda, SNS and SQS

outcomes.text: Angular unit-test coverage, enforced with SonarQube quality gates
Real-time instance notifications via SignalR replaced manual status checks

title: This Portfolio Site
tagline: Statically prerendered Angular 21 portfolio built with signals, zoneless change detection and data-driven content.
problem: I needed one fast, accessible place to show my work that recruiters can scan in seconds and search engines can index.
approach: Prerendered every route to static HTML with @angular/ssr for instant loads and SEO
Signals and zoneless change detection throughout, with OnPush standalone components
All content in JSON validated by zod schemas in unit tests, so the site, résumé and data stay consistent
Scroll-driven career timeline that respects reduced-motion preferences

outcomes.text: Every page and case study ships as static HTML
